1) Asha/Oliver: share vendor questionnaire (you mentioned via email) — thanks for sending that.
2) Internal (Rishi): draft incident response timeline and what we can share publicly vs. under NDA — target: 48 hours to share initial draft.
3) Internal (Marissa): pull SOC 2 Type II attestation PDF and list of in-scope services.
4) Internal (Laura): prepare compliance summary for GDPR/HIPAA applicability and encryption details for data at rest/in transit.

Thanks — I'll loop in Rishi/Laura/Marissa to pick this up internally and follow up with a draft pack by end of week.

Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. Attaching our vendor security questionnaire (initial version) for your team to complete.

A few clarifications from our side:
- Incident notification: FinTechCorp requires initial notification to our security inbox within 48 hours of detection for any incident that potentially affects customer data. We understand that initial notifications may be preliminary — we expect timely follow-ups as investigation progresses.
- Severity escalation: if data exfiltration is confirmed, we require a dedicated incident call within 4 hours of confirmation.
- BCP/RTO: please provide typical RTO/RPO targets for your service and any recent DR exercise dates we can reference.
- SOC 2: please share your most recent SOC 2 Type II report or a statement of in-scope services and effective dates.

Attachment: FinTechCorp_Vendor_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx

Jordan / team — thanks for the ping and Asha for the details. High-level answers and what we can share this week:

1) SOC 2: Redwood Inference has a SOC 2 Type II attestation covering our hosted API and associated control environment. We can share the SOC 2 report (redacted where necessary) and an in-scope services summary. (Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_Attestation_2025-09.pdf)

2) Incident notification timelines: our standard customer notification SLA in contracts is 72 hours from detection for initial notification. That said, we are willing to commit to an accelerated 48-hour initial notification for FinTechCorp pending legal approval. Operationally, we can provide preliminary notification within 48 hours and follow with investigation updates as they occur. For confirmed exfiltration events, we can commit to standing up a customer incident call within 4 hours of confirmation provided we have the required on-call engineer and security lead available.

3) IR timeline & artifacts: I attached a concise IR timeline PDF (IR_timelines.pdf) that outlines initial notification, triage, escalation, customer updates cadence, and final report timing.

4) BCP/DR evidence: we can provide recent DR exercise dates, RTO/RPO targets, and redacted runbook excerpts. I've attached a checklist of evidence we can share (BCP_evidence_list.txt) and included links to the shared drive doc for artifacts that require controlled access.

5) Data protection (GDPR/HIPAA): Laura will follow up with a short compliance summary covering encryption at rest/in-transit, data residency options, and any PII processing notes.

Attachments included in this reply: SOC2_TypeII_Attestation_2025-09.pdf (pdf, redacted), IR_timelines.pdf (pdf), BCP_evidence_list.txt (txt).

If FinTechCorp prefers a mutual NDA before receiving the SOC2 report and redacted runbooks, please let us know and I will loop legal. Otherwise we'll upload redacted artifacts to a gated Google Drive link and share access.

Next steps: Jordan to confirm whether we should request an NDA; Laura to send compliance summary; Marissa to confirm SOC2 upload and drive sharing.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
